compliance_requirement: Public service vehicles must be equipped with a Vehicle Location Tracking Device (VLTD).
notes: Mandatory GPS/VLTD fitment for public service vehicles.

topic: Revision of Driving Licence and Vehicle Registration Fees
compliance_requirement: Revised fee schedule for licensing and registration services: Learner Licence Issue — INR 150; Learner Licence Test — INR 50; Driving Test — INR 300; Driving Licence Issue — INR 200; International Driving Permit — INR 1000.
notes: Effective from date of publication in Gazette.

compliance_requirement: Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) mandatory for M1 and M2 category vehicles. Standards: M1 — IS 15986:2015; M2 — IS 11852:2003 Part 9.
notes: Phased rollout: new models from April 2018, all models from April 2019.

topic: Double Decker Bus Body Building Standard
compliance_requirement: Body building testing and approval must comply with AIS-139:2016. Compliance required within 6 months of notification.
Modification of provisions related to approved vehicle testing agencies and certification authorities.
notes: Affects vehicle type approval and certification processes.

topic: Use of Warning Lights on Vehicles
compliance_requirement: Restrictions on use of amber warning lights. Only emergency and disaster management vehicles may use specified warning lights. Removal of certain warning light permissions for general vehicles.
changes: Removal of certain warning light permissions
Emergency and disaster management vehicles only may use specified warning lights
notes: Restricts warning light usage to authorised emergency vehicles only.

topic: Amendment to Central Motor Vehicle Rules (2004)
compliance_requirement: General amendment to Central Motor Vehicle Rules.
Defines vehicle classification categories L (two/three-wheelers), M (passenger vehicles), and N (goods vehicles) in accordance with international standards.
notes: Foundational classification rule referenced by many subsequent amendments.

topic: Bharat Stage III Emission Standards for Two and Three Wheelers
compliance_requirement: Two-wheelers and three-wheelers must comply with Bharat Stage III (BS-III) emission standards.
penalty_reference: Sec 190(d) MV Act — driving a vehicle not meeting emission standards
notes: Superseded by BS-IV and BS-VI for new vehicles; reference for legacy compliance checks.

topic: Mandatory Reflective Tape / Rear Marking Requirements
compliance_requirement: Mandatory fitment of reflective tape and rear marking on vehicles as per prescribed specifications.
penalty_reference: Sec 177 MV Act — violation of rules duly promulgated
notes: Critical for night-time road safety; non-compliance treated as unsafe vehicle.

compliance_requirement: Further amendments to provisions governing approved vehicle testing agencies.
notes: Supplements G.S.R. 247(E) on testing agency provisions.

compliance_requirement: General amendment to Central Motor Vehicle Rules.
